pages.text: Giant wart bulbs on wartstalk trunks, studded with glowing bulbs. $(item)Wartvines$() hang everywhere, loaded with $(l)Wartfruits$(): the renewable food of the Nether. Hoglins, piglins and $(l)Cinder Lizards$() live here.
pages.title: Enchevêtrement

pages.text: Right-click a glowing vine to pick its fruits: they grow back. Place a fruit under a ceiling to plant a new vine.
